traps.description: Newsletters and promotions from Netflix, Max, Headspace and Dr. Squatch are not usage, receipts or price changes.
A look-alike 'your subscription has failed' email is not a receipt, a price change or a subscription, and raises nothing.
HBO MAX became MAX.COM (with a price rise). Max should be found, with its price increase.
A one-off Adobe Stock purchase should not hide the Adobe Creative Cloud subscription, and is not a subscription itself.
Spotify Family is found at the $19.99 charged; the Zelle paybacks are money in, not subscriptions.
GOOGLE *FIBER is an internet bill, not an unnamed Google Play subscription.
The Best Buy earbuds are cheaper now, but the 15-day window closed on Sep 23.
Rent paid by ACH every month is not a subscription.
Groceries, gas and coffee are not subscriptions.

Amazon Prime is billed once a year, so six months of bank data shows one charge; the renewal email names it.
Disney+ announced a rise to $18.99 from Nov 14. Nothing has been charged at the new price yet, so there is no price increase to flag.
GOOGLE *YouTubePremium is named from the Google Play receipt as YouTube Premium.
DashPass saved more than it cost in the last 30 days, so it is not losing money.
Promotions and newsletters from DoorDash, Uber, Netflix, Disney+, Peloton, Costco and LA Fitness are not usage or receipts.
Monthly prescription copays at the same amount are not a subscription.
The mortgage and the car loan are not subscriptions.
Groceries, gas and haircuts are not subscriptions.

traps.description: The Apple Music receipt is in Spanish. It is still an App Store receipt, and it names the APPLE.COM/BILL charge.
The Paramount+ 'trial ends in 3 days' email is heavy HTML. The trial should still be found.
Lyft charged twice on Sep 29 and refunded one on Oct 3. Nothing is left to dispute.
Mint Mobile bills every 3 months; it is still a bill.
Planet Fitness charges a $49 annual fee under the same name as the $10 monthly fee. The monthly membership should still be found.
The Levoit filter was bought in July 2026; the Levoit HEPA settlement covers 2019 to Aug 2023 purchases only.
The Walmart TV is cheaper now, but Walmart does not adjust prices.
Lufthansa cancelled LH 440 and she accepted the rebooking: EU261 compensation is owed, a cash refund of the fare is not.
Rent by Zelle and the monthly transfer to savings are not subscriptions.
Groceries, gas and coffee are not subscriptions.
